items.note: S1.3 gives h=100 triples, the eight-row schedule and the result (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored, but calls all three stages 'eight-row invocations' without saying stage 2 is the inverse schedule from Y to X, and omits the gate maps, neighbour rule and the net-change identity (JV+RG)x=x.

S1.4 states the frame rule, the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}, matching 804-825; an infer step with no sub-steps, so stated.

The form I-J/9, orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the lemma (only centre 3->4 edges decrease, by h; L=Ich; sum Wm-2N+2L) and the gate telescoping are correct, but the complex label field F_2^h, L_c/N=101/539 and the orthonormal-basis assertion are missing, and the explicit labels (A,P,B,Q, the time table eq:motif-labels and the residual table) that actually prove nesting are not given.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank = dimension change except N rank-one source edges, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, endpoint I_m and the shear on every role all match. The reason P_V-P_U has rank dimV-dimU and the endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I are asserted, not shown.

S2.1.1 states the kernel factorisation, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and C^{tensor m} after corrections, but the phase frame C_U = H diag(i^{wt(P_U x)}) H is never defined. The method names weight additivity mod 4 and Z/phase corrections but omits the character-to-translation step and the 27-coordinate endpoint computation.

For the bit network the chain L_b/N<1/2 -> deficit N-2L_b>0 -> eta>20*2^-50, log m<20 -> s_b/W_b<m^tau, tau=1-2^-50 is reproduced. The exact eta values are absent, and the complex side (L_c/N<1/2, deficit 2N-2L_c, s_c/W_c<m^sigma) is not drawn explicitly; sigma appears only as a fixed constant in S5.1.1.

Elementary operations and the controlled shift (with the paper's split-at-Q-a-and-merge mechanism) are correct, but S1.2's claim drops the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (present only in the quote) and the coprimality requirement for rational units.

Factorisation A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular changes by controlled shifts and the three-update interchange trick giving exactly a interchanges all match 1425-1446. The elimination proof of the factorisation (1375-1392) and the choice of an odd prime avoiding denominators are missing.

Row split to W streams of volume V/W, shear frames with endpoint I_m, the three-update interchange, s recursive calls, the fixed-tape schedule, the recurrence and its geometric sum all follow 1491-1615.
S1.7 summarises the padding to [q^e], high digits as rows padded to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces and the O(Vu^tau) total, consistent with 1649-1734. It is a single infer step, so stated.

Conjugation by P_M to coordinate kernels, one child per residual vector on a slot of f axes, inverse children via (-i)^f Z C Z, a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D all match.

Eight +-1 updates, guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, union bound with twenty excluded values, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B with radix-sort repair, and the o(1) extra terms all follow the proof. Only the separate handling of the top selected position j_{f-1} is omitted.

Rows from the first q_0=O(log d) chunks, V/W children and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves below d^{1/2} are correct. The unrolling is missing: K<=e^{c/beta} giving O(e^lambda), the leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}, and the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'.

Layer as phases around C^{tensor D}, recursion with packed basis changes, recurrence, guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20)=o(p) with p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits, and the row-sum-one disk argument all match the proof. The arithmetic-depth recurrence behind Delta is only stated.

Character cancellation by the t/2^{v+1} shift, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage B_t, the layout L of prefix moves and fewer than Dq chunk exchanges, per-round layer cost and the truncation-commutes argument for error sqrt2 l 2^-p all follow the paper.
B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the O(N log N) multiplier, centred residues with |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 and the O(rp log(rp)) cost match; a single infer step.
Two forward transforms kept in stored order, pointwise products divided by r, the opposite transform consuming that order, exact scaling by M, and the error M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^-p all match.

Gaussian identity T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, Neumann inversion of N=CTD, A=S/2, B_0=D'J'C with product of normalisations 2^{-2alpha^2}, sorts left in the identity, and the tensor form with axis exposure cost all match.
The chirp formula for QF_t and the cancellation (RF_s^+)[(RF_s u)(RF_s v)]=(u*v)/S^2 via F_s^+R=R^{-1}F_s^+ are stated correctly as infer steps.
Sizes, prime intervals, Bernoulli bound T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta>p and the n^{o(1)} prime search follow the paper. lambda=1-2^-52, eta=1/(4d) and alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) are not given explicitly.
Phi as an algebra isomorphism, the triangular digit update with mu_i=P_i^{-1}, prefix-controlled shifts preserving padding, and the O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) cost match.
The twist x_d->zeta y, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and the convolution formula are stated correctly; the twist error is not mentioned.
Source transform composition with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, and the six-step pipeline with the two scalings by S match.
E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and the carry invariant match. The intermediate E_w=S(3E_s+2) is skipped but the chain is otherwise intact.
Normalised costs as powers of p, min margin g_2=eps c(1-tau)=2^-181=2kappa from chunk exchanges, o(V) exceptional sorting, log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff all match.
S0 asserts that no eventual Omega(n log n) lower bound holds but never states what an eventual lower bound is or the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 criterion.

errors.says: The network is built from three stages of eight-row invocations, listing only the forward schedule (subtract side injection and scatter, copy, gather, scatter, side injection, undo gather, undo copy), and sends (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stage 1 and stage 3 are forward invocations from X to Y, but stage 2 runs the inverse forward schedule from Y to X, effecting X<-X-Y; this is what produces (x,y+x) -> (-y,y+x) -> (-y,x). Three forward stages would not give the exchange.

chain: The plan reaches the main bound by the paper's route: S1 builds the interchange from the bank-exchange network, frames, labels, the rank budget s_b<W_b m and the recurrence; S2 builds the simultaneous layer; S3-S7 then assemble the transform, convolution, resampling, CRT, exact recovery and cost table to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It is thinnest in the label construction, where the explicit gate labels and residual table that prove nesting are not given. It is also thin in the complex network's saving (phase frame undefined, L_c/N and s_c/W_c<m^sigma not drawn) and in the unrolling of the layer recurrence to d^{lambda'}.

steps.note: S1.3 gives the fixed linear network on three-element subsets of [100] exchanging the banks as (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire. N is described only as the number of data pairs and m only as the label dimension (implicit as dim of Q^100 tensor-cubed), with no explicit formulas.
Common frame per gate commuting with a pointwise gate, the implemented D_out S D_in^{-1}, edge cost D_v D_u^{-1}, and the route operator are all stated.
Nondegenerate tensor-product subspaces of F^{tensor 3} for gates and terminals, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing by h=100 are stated.
Edge rank equals dimension change for the projection matrices, with the N source edges as rank-one exceptions where the dimension change is zero. The P_V-P_U identity behind it is not spelled out.
L=Ich, sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L with the gate-telescoping reason, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are all stated.
L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and the deficit N-2L_b>0 give s_b<W_b m; the complex ratio 101/539 is not given.
Endpoint difference I_m on every role, giving H<-H+D on every original row including scratch rows.
E_1 Pi E_2 factorisation, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node are stated, together with the interchange trick.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^-50 from deficit >20*2^-50 and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present.

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content, in the order and roles the paper gives them: bank-exchange network, frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L_b/N=100/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50. The explicit formulas for N and m, the proof of the rank equality and the complex ratio are left implicit.
